description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Back-Up Switch Sensor for the 1985 – 1988 Samurai and SJ413.
Screws into the Transmission.
This switch activates the Reverse Lights when the Shifter is Moved into the Reverse Position. So if the reverse lights dont work on your Sammy then this is the likely culprit.
Metal plunger – longer than stock and may require washer as spacer
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Back-Up Switch Sensor
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
